senses.en: making you feel cooler, less tired, or more energetic
pleasantly different from what you usually experience

ex.en: A refreshing breeze blew through the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 一阵清爽的微风从敞开的厨房窗户吹进来。

ex.en: The documentary offers a refreshing perspective on how older people contribute to their local communities.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片以令人耳目一新的视角展现老年人如何为当地社区作出贡献。

col: refreshing change｜令人耳目一新的变化
tip: refreshing形容事物；refreshed形容人感到精神恢复。

senses.en: Feeling worried or uncomfortable about a situation.
Not fully settled, secure, or free from tension.

ex.en: I felt uneasy walking through the empty station.
ex.zh: 走过空荡荡的车站时，我感到有些不安。

ex.en: Many residents remain uneasy about the proposed factory because its environmental effects have not been fully assessed.
ex.zh: 许多居民仍对拟建工厂感到不安，因为其环境影响尚未得到全面评估。

col: uneasy about something｜对某事感到担忧
an uneasy truce｜不稳固的停战
tip: uneasy意为不安，不是“不容易”；常接about。

senses.en: An improvement or development in a particular field
Move forward or help something develop
Done or provided before a particular time or event

ex.en: This new treatment is a major advance in medicine.
ex.zh: 这种新疗法是医学上的一大进步。

ex.en: Advances in renewable energy technology could reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve long-term energy security.
ex.zh: 可再生能源技术的进步可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并改善长期能源安全。

tip: in advance表示提前；advanced表示先进的或高级的。

senses.en: The ability to live or act without relying on others.
A country's freedom from control by another country.

ex.en: Learning to cook gave him a sense of independence.
ex.zh: 学会做饭让他有了自立的感觉。

ex.en: Accessible housing can help older people maintain their independence while remaining connected to their local communities.
ex.zh: 无障碍住房可以帮助老年人保持独立生活，同时维系与当地社区的联系。

tip: 通常不可数；independence from表示不依赖或不受控制。

senses.en: real and exactly what it appears to be; sincere

ex.en: Her smile was genuine, and everyone felt welcome.
ex.zh: 她的微笑很真诚，每个人都感到受欢迎。

ex.en: To solve the problem, we need a genuine effort from both students and teachers.
ex.zh: 要解决这个问题，需要师生双方的真正努力。

tip: genuine强调“真”而非“假”，也指感情真诚；反义词是fake。

senses.en: feeling or showing thanks or praise
able to understand and enjoy something's value

ex.en: She gave me an appreciative smile after I helped her.
ex.zh: 我帮了她之后，她给了我一个感激的微笑。

ex.en: Students who are appreciative of their teachers' efforts often work harder and achieve better results.
ex.zh: 感激老师付出的学生往往更努力，成绩也更好。

tip: 常与of连用：be appreciative of sth。不要与appreciable（可观的）混淆。

senses.en: Extremely hot, especially when describing weather.

ex.en: We sheltered under a tree in the scorching heat.
ex.zh: 酷热中，我们躲到一棵树下乘凉。

ex.en: Increasingly frequent periods of scorching weather threaten crop yields and place additional pressure on water supplies.
ex.zh: 酷热天气越来越频繁，威胁作物产量，也给供水带来额外压力。

tip: 表示极热，常说scorching hot，一般不用very修饰。

senses.en: a set of actions always done in the same way
done as part of a ritual

ex.en: Having tea after dinner is a daily ritual for my grandparents.
ex.zh: 晚饭后喝茶是我祖父母的日常习惯。

ex.en: Many cultures have special rituals to celebrate the new year and bring good luck.
ex.zh: 许多文化有特别的仪式来庆祝新年并带来好运。

tip: 可指宗教仪式，也可指日常习惯性做法。

senses.en: Strong alcoholic drink made by distillation.

ex.en: The restaurant keeps its liquor in a locked cabinet.
ex.zh: 这家餐厅把烈酒存放在上锁的柜子里。

ex.en: Governments often impose higher taxes on liquor to discourage excessive consumption and protect public health.
ex.zh: 政府常对烈酒征收较高税款，以抑制过量饮用并保护公众健康。

tip: 通常指烈酒；liqueur则指利口酒，注意拼写。

senses.en: The process of choosing someone or something
A range of things available to choose from
A group of things chosen from a larger collection

ex.en: This little bakery has a wonderful selection of fresh bread.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店有各种很棒的新鲜面包可供挑选。

ex.en: Transparent selection procedures can help universities offer places fairly to applicants from a wide range of backgrounds.
ex.zh: 透明的选拔程序有助于大学公平地录取来自不同背景的申请者。

col: a wide selection of｜种类丰富的
tip: 表示挑选过程时通常不可数；一组选项可数。

senses.en: Towards the outside or away from the centre

ex.en: The windows open outwards, so keep the balcony clear.
ex.zh: 窗户向外开，所以请保持阳台通畅。

ex.en: As cities expand outwards, surrounding farmland often disappears, creating concerns about food security and habitat loss.
ex.zh: 随着城市向外扩张，周边农田往往逐渐消失，引发人们对粮食安全和栖息地流失的担忧。

tip: outwards 是副词；作定语需用 outward。

senses.en: The process of judging an approximate amount, size, or value.
An opinion about someone's character or something's value.

ex.en: By my estimation, we need three more chairs.
ex.zh: 据我估计，我们还需要三把椅子。

ex.en: Accurate estimation of construction costs helps local authorities avoid wasting public funds on unfinished projects.
ex.zh: 准确估算建筑成本有助于地方政府避免将公共资金浪费在未完工的项目上。

tip: estimation常指估算过程；具体估价常用estimate。

senses.en: the ability to act first without being told
a new plan to solve a problem

ex.en: Showing initiative at work can help you earn respect from your team.
ex.zh: 在工作中表现出主动性可以帮助你赢得团队的尊重。

ex.en: The school launched a new initiative to encourage students to read more books.
ex.zh: 学校发起了一项新倡议,鼓励学生多读书。

col: take the initiative｜带头；采取主动
tip: take the initiative to do sth 是“主动做某事”，写作常用。

senses.en: A plant whose dried leaves are used to make smoking products

ex.en: The farmer hung tobacco leaves inside a wooden barn.
ex.zh: 农民把烟叶挂在木制谷仓里。

ex.en: Higher taxes on tobacco products can discourage smoking and generate revenue for public health programmes.
ex.zh: 提高烟草制品税可以抑制吸烟，并为公共卫生项目筹集资金。

tip: 通常为不可数名词；一片烟叶用a tobacco leaf。

senses.en: a group chosen to discuss, judge, or advise
a flat piece forming part of a surface
a surface containing controls or instruments

ex.en: The panel listened carefully as each student presented an idea.
ex.zh: 每位学生陈述想法时，评审小组都认真倾听。

ex.en: An independent panel should assess the environmental impact of major construction projects before work begins.
ex.zh: 独立专家组应在重大建设项目开工前评估其环境影响。

col: a panel of experts｜专家小组
tip: 专家组用a panel of experts；成员称panellist。

senses.en: Made from clay or similar materials hardened by heat.
A material hardened by heat, or an object made from it.

ex.en: She keeps fresh flowers in a blue ceramic vase.
ex.zh: 她把鲜花插在一个蓝色陶瓷花瓶里。

ex.en: Ceramic tiles are widely used in public buildings because they are durable and relatively easy to clean.
ex.zh: 陶瓷砖耐用且较易清洁，因此广泛用于公共建筑。

tip: ceramics可指陶瓷制品，也可指陶艺或陶瓷工艺。

senses.en: Too small or unimportant to have much effect.

ex.en: The scratch is insignificant compared with the broken window.
ex.zh: 与破碎的窗户相比，这道划痕微不足道。

ex.en: Although individual savings may seem insignificant, widespread reductions in energy use can produce substantial environmental benefits.
ex.zh: 虽然个人节省的能源可能看似微不足道，但大范围降低能耗能够带来显著的环境效益。

col: an insignificant amount｜微不足道的量
tip: 强调不重要或影响小，不等同于meaningless。

senses.en: To ask for divine protection or favour for someone or something.
To give someone something good or fortunate.

ex.en: The priest paused to bless the family before their journey.
ex.zh: 神父停下来，为即将出行的一家人祈福。

ex.en: Regions blessed with abundant sunshine can develop solar energy to meet a growing share of their electricity needs.
ex.zh: 日照充足的地区可发展太阳能，以满足日益增长的电力需求。

tip: be blessed with表示有幸拥有某种优点或资源。

senses.en: An event causing great suffering, sadness, or loss.
A serious play or story ending in suffering or death.

ex.en: The whole village came together after the tragedy.
ex.zh: 惨剧发生后，全村人团结起来了。

ex.en: Improved road design and stricter safety regulations can help prevent the tragedy of avoidable traffic deaths.
ex.zh: 改进道路设计并加强安全规定，有助于防止本可避免的交通死亡悲剧。

tip: 既指现实中的惨事，也指文学悲剧；后者与comedy相对。

senses.en: A gathering of people for a shared purpose.
The process of joining parts to make something complete.
A group elected to discuss public matters and make laws.

ex.en: The whole school gathered in the hall for assembly.
ex.zh: 全校师生聚在礼堂里参加集会。

ex.en: Automation has reduced the time required for vehicle assembly, although skilled workers remain essential for quality control.
ex.zh: 自动化缩短了汽车组装所需的时间，但质量控制仍离不开技术工人。

tip: 集会义通常可数；组装义通常不可数。

senses.en: Make someone less willing or likely to do something
Make someone lose confidence or hope

ex.en: Heavy rain did not discourage us from walking outside.
ex.zh: 大雨并没有让我们放弃出门散步。

ex.en: Higher parking charges may discourage commuters from driving into city centres during peak hours.
ex.zh: 提高停车费可能会减少通勤者在高峰时段开车进入市中心的意愿。

col: discourage someone from doing something｜劝阻某人做某事
discourage car use｜减少汽车使用意愿
tip: 用discourage sb from doing，不用from to do。

senses.en: similarity between people or things, especially in appearance

ex.en: There is a striking resemblance between the two sisters.
ex.zh: 这两姐妹长得非常像。

ex.en: Modern housing developments often bear little resemblance to traditional neighbourhoods, particularly in their layout and use of shared space.
ex.zh: 现代住宅开发项目往往与传统街区大不相同，尤其是在布局和公共空间的使用方面。

col: a family resemblance｜家族成员间的相像
tip: resemblance to后接比较对象；resemble直接接宾语。

senses.en: A tiny burning particle or a brief flash of electricity.
To cause something to begin or develop suddenly.
A small amount of a quality, or something initiating change.

ex.en: A tiny spark flew out of the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁炉里飞出了一颗小火星。

ex.en: Investment in public libraries can spark interest in reading and provide valuable learning opportunities for disadvantaged children.
ex.zh: 对公共图书馆的投资可以激发阅读兴趣，并为弱势儿童提供宝贵的学习机会。

col: a spark of hope｜一丝希望
tip: 作动词可直接接interest、debate等，表示“引发”。

senses.en: to increase quickly to a very high level
to fly high in the air, often without moving wings

ex.en: Electricity bills soared during the unusually cold winter.
ex.zh: 在那个异常寒冷的冬天，电费猛涨。

ex.en: Housing prices may soar when population growth exceeds the supply of affordable homes in major cities.
ex.zh: 当人口增长超过大城市经济适用住房的供应能力时，房价可能飙升。

col: soar to record levels｜飙升至创纪录水平
tip: 表示价格等猛涨时为不及物动词，不直接接宾语。

senses.en: Wood collected or cut for burning as fuel.

ex.en: We stacked dry firewood beside the stove before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭前，我们把干柴堆在了炉子旁边。

ex.en: In some rural communities, dependence on firewood for cooking can contribute to deforestation and indoor air pollution.
ex.zh: 在一些农村社区，依赖柴火做饭可能加剧森林砍伐和室内空气污染。

col: a bundle of firewood｜一捆柴火
tip: 不可数名词；一块木柴可说a piece of firewood。

senses.en: to make something happen or exist again as it was
to enjoy yourself when you are not working

ex.en: The artist tried to recreate the colours of a sunset.
ex.zh: 这位艺术家试图再现日落的色彩。

ex.en: Scientists hope to recreate the conditions of the early universe in the laboratory.
ex.zh: 科学家们希望在实验室中重现早期宇宙的环境。

tip: 重读时表示'重现'，与 recreation（娱乐）意义不同。

senses.en: great sadness, especially after a loss

ex.en: The team suffered heartbreak when they lost the final match.
ex.zh: 球队在决赛中失利，感到极度悲伤。

ex.en: She wrote a song about heartbreak after her long relationship ended.
ex.zh: 她在长期恋爱关系结束后写了一首关于心碎的歌曲。

tip: heartbreak常指失恋或重大失败带来的痛苦。

senses.en: talk about other people's private lives, often not kind
to talk about other people's private lives

ex.en: She doesn't like gossip, so she never repeats what others say.
ex.zh: 她不喜欢八卦，所以从不传别人的话。

ex.en: In the age of social media, gossip can spread across a school in a few hours.
ex.zh: 在社交媒体时代，闲话可以在几小时内传遍整个学校。

tip: gossip 含贬义，常指背后议论他人私事；rumour 侧重未经证实的传闻。

senses.en: a situation where overcrowding prevents easy movement
a blockage caused by excess mucus or blood

ex.en: We left early to avoid congestion near the bridge.
ex.zh: 我们早早出发，以避开桥附近的拥堵。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can ease traffic congestion while reducing air pollution in major cities.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，同时减少大城市的空气污染。

tip: 通常不可数；traffic congestion指交通拥堵。

senses.en: an electronic instrument that produces sounds

ex.en: He played a tune on the synthesizer at the school concert.
ex.zh: 他在学校音乐会上用合成器演奏了一首曲子。

ex.en: Modern music often uses a synthesizer to create interesting sounds that traditional instruments cannot make.
ex.zh: 现代音乐经常使用合成器来创造传统乐器无法发出的有趣声音。

tip: synthesizer 是电子乐器，注意与 synthesis（合成）区分。

senses.en: A sudden strong desire to act without thinking carefully.
A brief electrical signal travelling through a nerve or circuit.
Something that encourages an activity or development.

ex.en: I bought this bright yellow umbrella on impulse.
ex.zh: 我一时冲动买了这把亮黄色的伞。

ex.en: Online retailers often encourage consumers to act on impulse by presenting discounts as available for a limited time.
ex.zh: 网络零售商常将折扣设为限时优惠，以此促使消费者冲动购物。

col: resist the impulse to｜克制做……的冲动
tip: on impulse表示一时冲动；后接动作常用impulse to do。

senses.en: A book giving practical information or instructions about a subject

ex.en: I checked the gardening handbook before pruning the rose.
ex.zh: 修剪玫瑰之前，我查阅了园艺手册。

ex.en: A comprehensive employee handbook helps new staff understand workplace procedures and reduces confusion about their responsibilities.
ex.zh: 一本全面的员工手册有助于新员工了解工作流程，减少他们对自身职责的困惑。

tip: 指便于查阅的实用指南，不是普通课本。

senses.en: not working during a particular period

ex.en: An off-duty nurse helped when my grandfather fell.
ex.zh: 我爷爷摔倒时，一位不当班的护士帮了忙。

ex.en: Providing comfortable accommodation allows off-duty staff to rest properly, improving their performance during subsequent shifts.
ex.zh: 提供舒适的住宿能让下班的员工充分休息，从而改善他们下一班的工作表现。

col: an off-duty nurse｜不当班的护士
tip: 名词前用off-duty；作表语通常写off duty。

senses.en: correct and free from mistakes
able to hit or reach the intended target

ex.en: This kitchen scale is accurate enough for baking bread.
ex.zh: 这台厨房秤的精度足以用来做面包。

ex.en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。

tip: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

senses.en: Large in amount, size, or degree.

ex.en: Repairing the roof took considerable time and effort.
ex.zh: 修理屋顶花了相当多的时间和精力。

ex.en: Expanding public transport requires considerable investment, but it can reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 扩大公共交通需要大量投资，但可以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

tip: considerable指数量或程度大；considerate指体贴的。

senses.en: showing politeness and consideration towards someone or something

ex.en: The children remained respectful while their grandmother was speaking.
ex.zh: 祖母讲话时，孩子们始终表现得很恭敬。

ex.en: Respectful discussion enables students to consider opposing views without allowing disagreement to damage their relationships.
ex.zh: 相互尊重的讨论使学生能够考虑不同观点，而不让分歧损害彼此的关系。

tip: respectful尊重他人的；respectable值得尊敬的。

senses.en: Relating to atomic nuclei or the energy they release.
Relating to the nucleus of a cell.

ex.en: My cousin works at a nearby nuclear power station.
ex.zh: 我表亲在附近的一座核电站工作。

ex.en: Nuclear energy can provide reliable electricity, but managing radioactive waste remains a major challenge.
ex.zh: 核能可以提供可靠的电力，但处理放射性废物仍是一大挑战。

tip: nuclear可指原子核或细胞核，依语境判断。

senses.en: An official rule controlling how something must be done.
The process of controlling an activity or maintaining a condition.

ex.en: Safety regulations require everyone here to wear a helmet.
ex.zh: 安全规定要求这里的每个人都戴头盔。

ex.en: Stricter regulation of industrial waste could reduce water pollution and improve public health in nearby communities.
ex.zh: 加强对工业废物的监管可以减少水污染，并改善附近社区的公众健康。

tip: 具体条例可数；表示监管这一过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: attractive and graceful in appearance or style
simple and effective in solving a problem

ex.en: She wore an elegant blue dress to dinner.
ex.zh: 她穿着一条优雅的蓝色连衣裙去赴晚宴。

ex.en: The architect proposed an elegant solution that improved ventilation without increasing the building's energy consumption.
ex.zh: 建筑师提出了一个简洁巧妙的方案，在不增加建筑能耗的情况下改善通风。

col: elegant solution｜简洁巧妙的解决方案
tip: 既可形容外观优雅，也可形容方案简洁巧妙。

senses.en: An object that protects someone or something from harm.
To protect someone or something from harm or exposure.

ex.en: The worker lowered a clear shield over her face.
ex.zh: 这名工人放下透明面罩，护住脸部。

ex.en: Urban trees can shield pedestrians from intense sunlight while reducing temperatures in densely populated neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 城市树木能为行人遮挡强烈阳光，同时降低人口密集街区的温度。

col: shield someone from harm｜保护某人免受伤害
tip: 动词常用shield someone from something。

senses.en: An indirect suggestion or clue that helps someone understand
To suggest something without stating it directly
A very small amount or slight sign of something

ex.en: Give me a hint about where you hid the gift.
ex.zh: 给我一点提示吧，你把礼物藏在哪里了？

ex.en: Survey responses hint at growing dissatisfaction with public transport, particularly among commuters living outside city centres.
ex.zh: 调查回复暗示，人们对公共交通的不满日益加深，住在市中心以外的通勤者尤其如此。

col: give someone a hint｜给某人提示
a hint of lemon｜一丝柠檬味
tip: 动词常用hint at sth或hint that从句。

senses.en: To change, or make something different.
To change clothing so that it fits better.

ex.en: Could you alter these trousers so they fit better?
ex.zh: 你能改一下这条裤子，让它更合身吗？

ex.en: Rising temperatures may alter rainfall patterns and create serious challenges for farmers in dry regions.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能改变降雨模式，给干旱地区的农民带来严峻挑战。

tip: 可及物也可不及物；altar是“祭坛”，勿混。

senses.en: very great pain or suffering

ex.en: He was in agony after breaking his leg.
ex.zh: 他摔断腿后痛苦不堪。

ex.en: Waiting for the exam results was agony for the whole class.
ex.zh: 等待考试结果对全班来说是一种煎熬。

col: cry out in agony｜痛苦地喊叫
tip: agony 比 pain 语气强，常指身心极度痛苦；in agony 是固定搭配。

senses.en: a formal statement given in court about what someone saw
clear proof that something is true or exists

ex.en: Her testimony in court helped the police understand what happened.
ex.zh: 她在法庭上的证词帮助警方了解了事情的经过。

ex.en: The clean rivers are testimony to years of hard work by local volunteers.
ex.zh: 清澈的河流是当地志愿者多年努力的证明。

col: bear testimony to｜证明；是……的见证
tip: 作证用 give testimony；bear testimony to 意为“证明”，常考搭配。

senses.en: Someone who risks money on uncertain outcomes
Someone willing to take risks for possible rewards

ex.en: The gambler left the table after losing his money.
ex.zh: 那个赌徒输掉钱后离开了赌桌。

ex.en: Support services can help a problem gambler regain financial stability and rebuild relationships with family members.
ex.zh: 支持服务可以帮助有赌博问题的人恢复财务稳定，并重建与家人的关系。

tip: gamble是赌博或冒险；gambler指从事这种行为的人。

senses.en: In the opposite direction to the movement of clock hands
Moving opposite to the direction of clock hands

ex.en: Turn the lid anticlockwise to open the jar.
ex.zh: 逆时针拧盖子，就能打开罐子。

ex.en: In the experiment, participants rotated a handle anticlockwise while researchers measured changes in muscle activity.
ex.zh: 实验中，参与者逆时针转动把手，研究人员同时测量肌肉活动的变化。

tip: 英式常用anticlockwise，美式常用counterclockwise。

senses.en: Too crowded with traffic or people to allow easy movement.
Blocked by too much mucus or blood.

ex.en: The roads were so congested that we walked home.
ex.zh: 道路堵得厉害，我们便走路回家了。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic on congested roads and improve air quality in cities.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以减少拥堵道路上的车辆，并改善城市空气质量。

col: a congested city centre｜拥挤的市中心
tip: 既可形容交通拥堵，也可形容鼻腔等堵塞。

senses.en: Being the final or most important aim or result.
The best or most extreme example of something.

ex.en: Our ultimate goal is to buy a small house.
ex.zh: 我们的最终目标是买一栋小房子。

ex.en: The ultimate aim of public transport investment should be to provide affordable and reliable travel for everyone.
ex.zh: 公共交通投资的最终目标应是为所有人提供价格合理、可靠的出行服务。

col: the ultimate in comfort｜极致舒适
tip: ultimate强调最终目标或极致，不指最近一次。

senses.en: whole or complete

ex.en: He spent the entire day cleaning his room.
ex.zh: 他花了一整天打扫房间。

ex.en: The entire class worked together to plant trees in the school garden.
ex.zh: 全班一起在学校花园里植树。

tip: entire 通常作定语，修饰单数名词，如 the entire city。

senses.en: to broadcast something on television

ex.en: The school concert will be televised so that parents can watch at home.
ex.zh: 学校音乐会将进行电视转播，以便家长在家观看。

ex.en: The science competition was televised to encourage more young people to take an interest in research.
ex.zh: 这场科学竞赛被电视转播，以鼓励更多年轻人对研究产生兴趣。

col: televise a match｜电视转播比赛
tip: televise 是及物动词，常用被动式 be televised；不要与 television 混淆。

senses.en: control an activity through rules or laws
adjust something to maintain a suitable level or rate

ex.en: This small device helps regulate the temperature indoors.
ex.zh: 这个小装置有助于调节室内温度。

ex.en: Governments should regulate industrial emissions to protect public health without placing unnecessary burdens on small businesses.
ex.zh: 政府应监管工业排放，在保护公众健康的同时，避免给小企业增加不必要的负担。

col: regulate an industry｜监管一个行业
tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；regulate temperature指调温。

senses.en: a feeling of extreme happiness or excitement

ex.en: She was in ecstasy when she heard she had won the prize.
ex.zh: 听到自己获奖时，她欣喜若狂。

ex.en: The fans went into ecstasy when their team scored the winning goal in the final minute.
ex.zh: 当球队在最后一分钟攻入制胜球时，球迷们欣喜若狂。

tip: 注意 ecstasy 是名词，形容词是 ecstatic。

senses.en: Not often; on very few occasions.

ex.en: We seldom eat out because we enjoy cooking together.
ex.zh: 我们很少外出吃饭，因为我们喜欢一起做饭。

ex.en: Rural communities seldom receive the same level of public transport investment as major urban centres.
ex.zh: 农村社区很少获得与主要城市中心同等水平的公共交通投资。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；置于句首常需倒装。

senses.en: a setting used automatically unless you choose another
failure to pay a debt or fulfil a legal obligation
to fail to pay a debt or meet an obligation

ex.en: This app uses a dark background by default.
ex.zh: 这个应用默认使用深色背景。

ex.en: Borrowers are more likely to default on their loans when unemployment rises and household incomes fall.
ex.zh: 当失业率上升、家庭收入下降时，借款人更容易拖欠贷款。

col: default on a loan｜拖欠贷款
tip: by default 表示默认；拖欠贷款用 default on a loan。

senses.en: shining with many small flashes of light
containing bubbles of gas

senses.zh: 生动有趣的；才华横溢的
senses.en: lively, clever, and entertaining

ex.en: She held the sparkling bracelet up to the sunlight.
ex.zh: 她把闪闪发亮的手链举到阳光下。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce packaging waste by serving locally filtered sparkling water rather than imported bottled alternatives.
ex.zh: 餐厅可以供应本地过滤的气泡水，代替进口瓶装水，从而减少包装废弃物。

tip: 饮用水中sparkling指含气泡，still指无气泡。

senses.en: to change something to its opposite, or move backwards
going in the opposite direction or order
the opposite of something, or its back surface

ex.en: He reversed the car slowly into the garage.
ex.zh: 他慢慢地把车倒进车库。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy could help reverse the recent rise in emissions from electricity generation.
ex.zh: 对可再生能源的投资可能有助于扭转近期发电排放量上升的趋势。

tip: 倒车用reverse；撤销决定可说reverse a decision。

senses.en: money given by an organisation for a particular purpose
to officially give someone something they request
to accept that something is true, often reluctantly

ex.en: A small grant helped us repair the village playground.
ex.zh: 一笔小额补助金帮助我们修好了村里的游乐场。

ex.en: Governments should provide research grants to universities developing affordable technologies for reducing household energy consumption.
ex.zh: 政府应向研发低成本家庭节能技术的大学提供研究拨款。

col: apply for a grant｜申请补助金
take something for granted｜认为某事理所当然
tip: grant sb sth可改为grant sth to sb。

senses.en: someone authorised to assist or act for a more senior person
an elected member of parliament in some countries

ex.en: The manager asked her deputy to lead today's meeting.
ex.zh: 经理让她的副手主持今天的会议。

ex.en: Appointing a capable deputy allows school leaders to share administrative responsibilities and focus on educational improvement.
ex.zh: 任命一位能干的副职能让学校领导分担行政职责，并专注于教育改进。

tip: 常置于职务前，如deputy director；不泛指所有代表。

senses.en: Done without enough thought about possible risks or consequences.
An area of irritated skin covered with spots.

ex.en: It was rash to leave without checking the weather.
ex.zh: 没有查看天气就出发，实在太轻率了。

ex.en: Rash decisions about urban development can leave communities with inadequate transport and limited access to green spaces.
ex.zh: 关于城市发展的轻率决策可能导致社区交通不足，且居民难以享有绿地。

tip: 作形容词指鲁莽；作名词指皮疹，常用a rash。

senses.en: a wide, beautiful view of scenery
a mental view of what may happen in the future

ex.en: From the top of the hill we enjoyed a wide vista of green fields.
ex.zh: 从山顶上，我们欣赏到开阔的绿色田野景色。

ex.en: New technology opens a fresh vista of possibilities for students in small towns.
ex.zh: 新技术为小城镇的学生展现出新的前景与可能。

col: a vista of the valley｜山谷的景色
open up new vistas｜展现新的前景
tip: 正式用语，多用于书面描写景色或前景；日常口语更常说 view。

senses.en: Parts left after something has been used, damaged, or destroyed.
Surviving parts of ancient buildings or objects.
The body or bones of a dead person or animal.

ex.en: The remains of our picnic filled a small bag.
ex.zh: 我们野餐后剩下的东西装满了一个小袋子。

ex.en: The remains of ancient settlements provide valuable evidence about how early communities adapted to environmental change.
ex.zh: 古代聚落遗迹为了解早期群体如何适应环境变化提供了宝贵证据。

col: the remains of a meal｜餐后剩余物
tip: 作名词用复数谓语；也可为remain的单数动词形式。

senses.en: like a pearl, especially in colour or shine
decorated with pearls

ex.en: The sky turned a pearly pink just before sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出前天空变成了珍珠般的粉红色。

ex.en: Her pearly smile lit up the room when she heard the good news.
ex.zh: 听到好消息时，她那珍珠般的笑容照亮了整个房间。

tip: pearly 是 pear 的形容词形式，但 pear 指“梨”，两者无关；pearl 才是珍珠。

senses.en: the base remaining after a tree or object is cut
to leave someone unable to answer or solve something

ex.en: We sat on a tree stump to eat lunch.
ex.zh: 我们坐在一个树桩上吃午饭。

ex.en: Removing tree stumps can disturb forest soils and destroy habitats used by insects and other small organisms.
ex.zh: 清除树桩可能扰动森林土壤，破坏昆虫和其他小型生物的栖息地。

col: be stumped by a question｜被问题难倒
tip: be stumped by表示被难倒，并非被绊倒。

senses.en: To bring food or liquid from the stomach through the mouth.
Food or liquid brought up from the stomach.

ex.en: The rough boat ride made several passengers vomit.
ex.zh: 船在航行中剧烈颠簸，导致几位乘客呕吐。

ex.en: Patients who vomit repeatedly may become dehydrated and should seek medical advice if symptoms persist.
ex.zh: 反复呕吐的患者可能出现脱水，若症状持续，应咨询医生。

tip: 名词指呕吐物；呕吐这一过程常用vomiting。

senses.en: in a basic and important way

ex.en: The two plans are fundamentally different in their goals and methods.
ex.zh: 这两个计划在目标和方法上根本不同。

ex.en: Education is fundamentally important for helping young people understand the world.
ex.zh: 教育对于帮助年轻人理解世界是根本重要的。

tip: fundamentally表示“从根本上”，常修饰different、change等词。

senses.en: a major change in government, often achieved by force
a dramatic change in how something works or is done
one complete turn around a point or axis

ex.en: The museum has a room devoted to the revolution.
ex.zh: 博物馆有一个专门介绍这场革命的展厅。

ex.en: The digital revolution has transformed education by allowing students to access learning materials from almost anywhere.
ex.zh: 数字革命让学生几乎随时随地都能获取学习资料，从而改变了教育。

tip: revolution强调根本变革；reform通常指渐进改革。

senses.en: the use of resources, energy, goods, or services
the act or amount of eating or drinking something

ex.en: Our electricity consumption rises when we use the heater.
ex.zh: 使用暖气时，我们的用电量就会上升。

ex.en: Governments can reduce fossil fuel consumption by investing in reliable public transport and renewable energy.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资可靠的公共交通和可再生能源，减少化石燃料消耗。

col: fit for human consumption｜适合人类食用
tip: 通常不可数；消费的人是consumer，不是consumption。

senses.en: continuing or having effects over a long period

ex.en: We need a long-term plan for our garden.
ex.zh: 我们需要为花园制定一个长期规划。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can bring long-term benefits to both local economies and the environment.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以为地方经济和环境带来长期效益。

tip: 作定语常用连字符；in the long term不加。

senses.zh: 坐立不安的；难以休息的
senses.en: Unable to relax, stay still, or sleep peacefully.
Eager for change because the present situation feels unsatisfying.

ex.en: The restless child kept swinging her legs under the table.
ex.zh: 那个坐不住的孩子不停地在桌下晃腿。

ex.en: Students may become restless during lengthy lectures if they have few opportunities to participate actively.
ex.zh: 如果缺少积极参与的机会，学生在长时间的讲座中可能会坐立不安。

col: a restless spirit｜不甘安定的性情
tip: restless指难以安静；restful指令人放松的。

senses.en: on something, especially in formal or literary language
immediately after or at the time of an event

ex.en: The cat rested upon a cushion beside the window.
ex.zh: 猫趴在窗边的垫子上休息。

ex.en: Upon completing their training, new teachers should receive ongoing support from experienced colleagues at school.
ex.zh: 新教师完成培训后，应持续获得校内资深同事的支持。

tip: 比on正式；upon doing表示“一……就”。

senses.en: relating to mathematics

ex.en: This puzzle really puts your mathematical skills to work.
ex.zh: 这道谜题真能让你运用数学技能。

ex.en: Mathematical models help researchers predict how rising temperatures may affect coastal communities over time.
ex.zh: 数学模型帮助研究人员预测气温上升可能如何逐步影响沿海社区。

tip: mathematics是学科名，虽以s结尾但用单数谓语。

senses.en: in the middle of a group; among

ex.en: He was the tallest amongst all the players.
ex.zh: 他是所有球员中最高的。

ex.en: Amongst the many problems facing teens, lack of sleep is perhaps the easiest to solve.
ex.zh: 在青少年面临的许多问题中，睡眠不足或许是最容易解决的。

col: amongst other things｜除了别的之外
tip: amongst 与 among 同义，英式书面中常见，考试写 among 更稳妥。

senses.en: Unfair treatment or a particular example of it.

ex.en: We challenged the injustice of excluding her from the team.
ex.zh: 我们对将她排除在队伍之外的不公正做法提出了质疑。

ex.en: Access to affordable legal advice is essential for people seeking to challenge injustice in the workplace.
ex.zh: 对于想要挑战职场不公的人来说，获得负担得起的法律咨询至关重要。

col: a sense of injustice｜不公平感
suffer an injustice｜遭受不公正待遇
tip: 泛指不公时不可数；具体不公事件可用 an injustice。

senses.en: A book or other product that sells in very large quantities.

ex.en: Her first novel became a bestseller within weeks.
ex.zh: 她的第一部小说几周内就成了畅销书。

ex.en: A bestseller can introduce complex scientific ideas to readers who rarely engage with academic publications.
ex.zh: 畅销书能向很少接触学术出版物的读者介绍复杂的科学概念。

tip: 指畅销书或商品，不指畅销书作者。

senses.en: The process of repairing and improving a building or room.

ex.en: We stayed with friends during the renovation of our kitchen.
ex.zh: 厨房翻修期间，我们住在朋友家。

ex.en: The renovation of historic buildings can preserve local identity while providing suitable spaces for modern businesses.
ex.zh: 翻修历史建筑既能保留地方特色，也能为现代商业提供合适的空间。

tip: 主要指建筑翻修；制度革新通常不用此词。

senses.en: A unit of land area equal to about 4,047 square metres

ex.en: Their vegetable garden covers almost an acre behind the house.
ex.zh: 他们屋后的菜园占地近一英亩。

ex.en: Protecting each acre of wetland helps preserve wildlife habitats and reduces the risk of local flooding.
ex.zh: 保护每一英亩湿地都有助于维护野生动物栖息地，并降低当地发生洪灾的风险。

col: an acre of land｜一英亩土地
tip: 面积单位：1英亩约4047平方米，不等于一公顷。

senses.en: The process of developing or bringing something into existence.
A natural structure with a particular shape or arrangement.
An organised arrangement of people, vehicles, or animals.

ex.en: Cold nights encourage the formation of ice on puddles.
ex.zh: 寒冷的夜晚容易使水洼表面结冰。

ex.en: Scientists study the formation of clouds to improve weather forecasts and understand changes in the global climate.
ex.zh: 科学家研究云的形成，以改进天气预报并了解全球气候的变化。

col: the formation of a government｜政府的组建
tip: formation可指形成过程，也可指形成的结构或队形。

senses.en: involving much work or effort within a short period
using large amounts of resources to produce high output

ex.en: I took an intensive swimming course during the holidays.
ex.zh: 假期里我参加了一个游泳强化课程。

ex.en: Intensive farming can increase food production, but it may also damage soil quality and reduce biodiversity.
ex.zh: 集约化农业可以提高粮食产量，但也可能损害土壤质量并减少生物多样性。

tip: intensive 强调集中投入；intense 强调感受或程度强烈。

senses.en: to push something into a small space
to cover someone in bed with blankets
a fold sewn into clothing

ex.en: She tucked the map into her pocket before leaving.
ex.zh: 她离开前把地图塞进了口袋。

ex.en: The mother tucked her son into bed and read him a short story.
ex.zh: 母亲把儿子掖好被子，给他读了一个短篇故事。

col: tuck in｜塞进；掖好；<英>痛快吃
tip: tuck 常与 in/into/away 搭配；tuck into 在英式英语中意为“大口吃”。

senses.en: Thin ice crystals on surfaces, or weather that forms them.
To cover or become covered with a thin layer of ice.
To cover a cake with a sweet, creamy topping.

ex.en: A thin frost covered the grass outside our kitchen.
ex.zh: 厨房外的草地上覆盖着一层薄霜。

ex.en: Unexpected spring frost can damage young crops, reducing yields and increasing financial pressure on farmers.
ex.zh: 突如其来的春季霜冻会损伤幼苗，降低产量并增加农民的经济压力。

col: frost a cake｜给蛋糕涂糖霜
tip: frost是霜，不是雪；涂糖霜这一动词义多见于美语。

senses.en: Exactly and accurately, without any difference or error.
Used to emphasize that something is exactly the case.

ex.en: The carpenter cut each shelf precisely to fit the cupboard.
ex.zh: 木匠精确裁切了每块搁板，使其与柜子吻合。

ex.en: Researchers must measure changes in sea level precisely to assess the long-term effects of climate change.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须精确测量海平面的变化，以评估气候变化的长期影响。

tip: precisely because表示“正是因为”，强调原因。

senses.en: the time before written records existed

ex.en: People lived in caves during prehistory and used stone tools.
ex.zh: 史前时期人们住在洞穴里并使用石制工具。

ex.en: Scientists study prehistory by examining ancient bones, tools and cave paintings found across the world.
ex.zh: 科学家通过研究世界各地发现的古老骨骼、工具和洞穴壁画来研究史前史。

col: the study of prehistory｜史前研究
tip: pre-表示“在前”，history是“历史”，合起来指有文字记录之前。

senses.en: to identify an illness by examining symptoms and test results
to identify the cause or nature of a problem

ex.en: The doctor diagnosed asthma after checking my breathing.
ex.zh: 医生检查我的呼吸情况后，诊断我患有哮喘。

ex.en: New screening technologies can help doctors diagnose certain diseases before serious symptoms appear.
ex.zh: 新的筛查技术可以帮助医生在严重症状出现前诊断出某些疾病。

tip: 诊断某人患病用diagnose someone with某病。

senses.en: two or more things joined or used together
a sequence used to open a lock

ex.en: This soup has a delicious combination of herbs and vegetables.
ex.zh: 这道汤把香草与蔬菜搭配得十分美味。

ex.en: A combination of affordable housing and reliable public transport can improve living standards in growing cities.
ex.zh: 经济适用的住房与可靠的公共交通相结合，可以提高发展中城市的生活水平。

tip: 常用a combination of A and B表示两者结合。

senses.en: Extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: An immense ship blocked our view of the harbour.
ex.zh: 一艘巨轮挡住了我们望向港口的视线。

ex.en: The transition to renewable energy requires immense investment but can deliver substantial environmental and economic benefits.
ex.zh: 向可再生能源转型需要巨额投资，但能带来显著的环境和经济效益。

tip: 既可形容体积巨大，也可形容压力、潜力等程度极大。

senses.en: to lose colour or make something lose colour gradually
to become weaker, less clear, or less noticeable over time

ex.en: The curtains have faded after years of bright sunlight.
ex.zh: 窗帘经过多年强烈日晒，已经褪色了。

ex.en: Public interest in environmental campaigns may fade unless organisations provide regular updates and opportunities for participation.
ex.zh: 如果组织不定期提供最新进展和参与机会，公众对环保活动的兴趣可能会逐渐减退。

col: fade in the sun｜在阳光下褪色
fade into the background｜逐渐不再引人注意
tip: 强调逐渐变化；fade away指慢慢减弱或消失。

senses.en: To make an edge or point sharper.
To make a skill, sense, or quality more effective.

ex.en: I sharpened my pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
ex.zh: 画那只熟睡的猫之前，我削尖了铅笔。

ex.en: Classroom debates can sharpen students' critical thinking skills by encouraging them to examine competing arguments.
ex.zh: 课堂辩论鼓励学生审视相互对立的论点，从而提高批判性思维能力。

tip: sharp加-en构成动词，也可比喻提升技能。

senses.en: A gas whose molecules each contain three oxygen atoms.

ex.en: High ozone levels kept us from jogging outside today.
ex.zh: 今天臭氧浓度高，我们没有到户外慢跑。

ex.en: While ozone high in the atmosphere protects life, ground-level ozone can damage human health and crops.
ex.zh: 尽管高空中的臭氧能保护生命，近地面的臭氧却会损害人体健康和农作物。

tip: 臭氧不可数；高空臭氧有保护作用，近地面臭氧有害。

senses.en: A temporary job that provides practical experience during training.
The act of putting something in a particular position.
The act of finding someone a suitable position or home.

ex.en: I learned practical skills during my hospital placement.
ex.zh: 我在医院实习期间学到了实用技能。

ex.en: Universities should offer work placements so that students can apply classroom knowledge in professional settings.
ex.zh: 大学应提供实习机会，让学生能够在职场环境中运用课堂知识。

tip: 英式英语中work placement常指课程中的实习。

senses.en: the way information or an event is arranged or presented
to arrange the appearance of a document or information
to prepare a storage device so it can store data

ex.en: Please send the photos in a different file format.
ex.zh: 请换一种文件格式发送这些照片。

ex.en: Offering course materials in a digital format can make education more accessible to students in remote areas.
ex.zh: 以数字格式提供课程材料，可以让偏远地区的学生更容易获得教育资源。

col: format a document｜设置文档格式
tip: 动词过去式formatted，现在分词formatting。

senses.en: the systems that keep places clean and healthy, like toilets and waste removal

ex.en: The village finally got clean water and proper sanitation last year.
ex.zh: 这个村子去年终于有了干净的水和像样的卫生设施。

ex.en: Poor sanitation can quickly spread disease in crowded cities, so clean water matters a lot.
ex.zh: 糟糕的卫生条件会让疾病在拥挤的城市迅速传播，所以干净的水非常重要。

col: clean water and sanitation｜清洁水和卫生设施
tip: 多指公共环境卫生；联合国可持续发展目标之一就是 water and sanitation。

senses.en: new and different in a way that leads to change

ex.en: The scientist presented groundbreaking ideas at the conference.
ex.zh: 这位科学家在会议上提出了开创性的想法。

ex.en: Groundbreaking technology can improve education for students in remote areas.
ex.zh: 突破性技术可以改善偏远地区学生的教育。

tip: groundbreaking 是美式常见拼写，英式也常带连字符 ground-breaking，意思相同。

senses.en: Relating to the former Soviet Union or its governing councils.
A citizen of the former Soviet Union.

ex.en: My grandfather kept a Soviet camera in this drawer.
ex.zh: 我祖父在这个抽屉里存放过一台苏联相机。

ex.en: Researchers study Soviet housing policies to understand how central planning influenced urban development and everyday life.
ex.zh: 研究人员通过考察苏联的住房政策，了解中央计划如何影响城市发展和日常生活。

tip: Soviet通常大写；小写soviet可指苏维埃议会。

senses.en: To strongly encourage someone to do something.
A strong desire to do something.

ex.en: I resisted the urge to eat another biscuit.
ex.zh: 我忍住了再吃一块饼干的冲动。

ex.en: Health experts urge governments to invest in preventive care rather than focus solely on treating diseases.
ex.zh: 健康专家敦促政府投资预防保健，而不是只关注疾病治疗。

col: urge someone to do something｜敦促某人做某事
a strong urge to｜想……的强烈冲动
tip: 动词用urge sb to do；名词用an urge to do。

senses.en: Relating to the structure or management of an organization.
Relating to planning activities and arranging things effectively.

ex.en: The new manager announced several organizational changes this morning.
ex.zh: 新经理今天上午宣布了几项组织调整。

ex.en: A clear organizational structure can improve communication between departments and help employees understand their responsibilities.
ex.zh: 清晰的组织架构可以改善部门间的沟通，并帮助员工明确职责。

tip: 英式也写作organisational。

senses.en: A large, thick piece of something.
A substantial part of an amount or whole.

ex.en: She dropped a chunk of cheese into the soup.
ex.zh: 她把一大块奶酪放进了汤里。

ex.en: Housing costs consume a large chunk of household income, leaving less money for education and leisure.
ex.zh: 住房开支占据了家庭收入的很大一部分，使可用于教育和休闲的钱减少了。

col: a chunk of bread｜一大块面包
a large chunk of｜很大一部分
manageable chunks｜便于处理的小部分
tip: 可指实物的大块，也可指时间或金钱的一大部分。

senses.en: Neither very large nor very small in amount or degree
Avoiding extreme political views or actions
To become or make something less extreme or intense

ex.en: A moderate amount of exercise helps me sleep better.
ex.zh: 适量运动能让我睡得更好。

ex.en: Moderate increases in housing density could accommodate urban growth without placing excessive pressure on local infrastructure.
ex.zh: 适度提高住房密度可以满足城市发展的需求，同时避免给当地基础设施造成过大压力。

col: moderate your expectations｜适当降低期望
tip: 形容词末尾读/ət/，动词末尾读/eɪt/。

senses.en: deep emotional pain or sadness

ex.en: Losing her best friend caused her great heartache.
ex.zh: 失去最好的朋友让她非常悲痛。

ex.en: The novel describes the heartache of a family torn apart by war.
ex.zh: 这部小说描述了一个被战争撕裂的家庭的悲痛。

tip: heartache指情感上的痛苦，不是身体疼痛。

senses.en: willing to help others or work together
a business owned and run jointly by its members

ex.en: Everyone was cooperative when we rearranged the shared kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们重新布置共用厨房时，大家都很配合。

ex.en: Cooperative learning can help students develop communication skills while taking shared responsibility for completing a task.
ex.zh: 合作学习可以帮助学生培养沟通技能，同时共同承担完成任务的责任。

tip: 作形容词表示合作；作名词指合作社。

senses.en: done by choice rather than because it is required
done without payment to help people or an organisation

ex.en: Joining the weekend walking group is completely voluntary.
ex.zh: 参加周末步行小组完全出于自愿。

ex.en: Voluntary work can help young people develop practical skills while contributing to their local communities.
ex.zh: 志愿工作既能帮助年轻人培养实用技能，也能让他们为当地社区作贡献。

tip: voluntary是形容词；“志愿者”用volunteer。
